title: capsicum annuum var. luteum
intro: Capsicum annuum var. luteum, commonly known as yellow bell pepper, is a variety of the capsicum annuum plant, characterized by its bright yellow fruit. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been associated with several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of yellow bell pepper are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include carotenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of yellow bell pepper also include capsicum, capsidiol, and capsianosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
